greedy_tail_recycling.decision: Rejected: recycling an unused suffix once preserves all 6 checked AR continuations, but prose slows 8.79%, JSON 4.21%, repetition 0.12%. Both source files and persistent-state changes reverted. Full state/sampling qualification was not pursued after the failed speed pilot.

evidence.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft C1 greedy adaptive7 pilot, one paired sample per case after128 rawprose tokens warmup per binary. Rawprose/JSON TG300 and chatrepetition TG128, includes prefill/excludes load. Candidate reuses the unused greedy tail once when a fresh proposal matched at least one token and at least two remain after correction. Sampling and fixed policy do not recycle; all recycled proposals undergo normal exact target verification. Controller costs and EMA unchanged. Persistent v3 carries the cached tail. This is a pilot, not complete state/sampling qualification.

limits: Two timed samples per binary/workload in ABBA order after warmup: short controls, not a significance study. Prose +0.24%, JSON +0.18%, repetition +0.02% (flat).
The prose profile observes verification widths 2–7; the isolated actual-weight pair probe includes 3/5/8, and the maintained operator/model checks cover all supported widths. No C>1 throughput claim.

Full Q4/Q8 target logit/feature/replay/context and affected Q8 kernel suites passed. Unchanged draft operator/sampling/HTTP/depth matrices were not repeated. Prior qualification remains indexed in eval/README.md.

These checks establish no regression in the tested outputs and exact operator arithmetic. Independent original-target/checkpoint/MTP quality gaps remain open. No 75-question capability comparison was run.
